title: Tackling Alcohol-Fuelled Violence: 2am statewide trading cap (Queensland)
summary: From 1 July 2016 the latest extended liquor trading time was cut to 2am statewide (3am in 15 Safe Night Precincts until 31 January 2017, then only approved licensees in prescribed 3am precincts, with a 1am lockout scheduled from 1 February 2017).

instruments.title: Tackling Alcohol-fuelled Violence Legislation Amendment Act 2016
instruments.provisions: Inserts s 337 and ss 142AA-142AB into Liquor Act 1992

instruments.title: Liquor (3a.m. Safe Night Precincts) Amendment Regulation 2016

commenced.what: Extended liquor trading capped at 2am statewide (3am in SNPs)
Scheduled start of 3am-SNP-only regime and 1am lockout (lockout later repealed)

direction_rationale: Shorter permitted trading hours reduce late-night venues' ability to compete on hours and may push marginal venues to exit.
comparison: Other states' late-night venues (NSW lockouts were precinct-only)
confounders: Liquor and Other Legislation Amendment Act 2017 repealing lockout
notes: The 1am lockout was repealed by the Liquor and Other Legislation Amendment Bill 2017 (passage date not verified).

verified.notes: Assent date (4 Mar 2016) and commencement are from the Queensland explanatory note for SL 2016 No. 231.
